read: 2026-10-14, by eye from the schematic in PedalBuilder's forum post
comment: PedalBuilder's take on the Sola Sound Yellow Hybrid Tone Bender: two Supa Tone Bender (Big Muff style) gain stages, a third stage with a Zener-referenced, diode-biased germanium Q3 as in a Tone Bender Mk. III, and a Big Muff style tone stack. The drawing gives the stock values in blue and his mods in red; the rows carry the red (built) values with the stock value in the note.
uncertain: R101: LED resistor drawn as 'CLR' with no value
rows: LED current limiting resistor, drawn as CLR
mod, drawn as 150n+22µ (stock 10n): a 150n on the board
mod: the 22µ electrolytic beside C5's 150n, on the back of the board (from the post)
mod: bridges lugs 3 and 2 of the Sustain pot (designator not drawn)
mod; stock B100K; the post says an A250k wired backwards stands in for a C250k, and calls it the Fuzz (now Balance) control
